title: ECBD: Evidence-Centered Benchmark Design for NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the validity of benchmark metrics (such as those in HELM) that measure bias by counting occurrences of words related to specific demographic groups (e.g., 'White', 'Hispanic', 'Asian') in model outputs and comparing them to a uniform distribution.

Critiquing the methodological justification of benchmarks that re-purpose datasets (like BoolQ) to measure social bias, and examining whether test items in stereotyping benchmarks actually capture harmful stereotypes versus factual statements.
